summary: One-line change sets `not_in_args = []` on the `String` Token subclass so `text` becomes a positional arg, making `expr.func(*expr.args) == expr` hold as required for any Basic subclass. Minimal, correct, directly resolves the issue.

issues.description: Moving `text` into `args` changes `String.args` from empty to `(text,)`, which could in theory affect code traversing args of a String atom; tests pass and this is the intended semantics, so non-blocking.
